name: @vssaros/dsh-unreal
description: VsSaros Unreal Engine bridge module for DeepSeek Harness: exposes the read-only unreal_* tools by calling the editor's local /bridge/* HTTP endpoints FROM THE HOST PROCESS, so the family keeps working when the Host runs without VsSaros. Ported from src/vs/sessions/contrib/agentStudio/browser/providers/tool/unrealTools.ts. Registers all seven unreal_* tools (the read-only four plus exec/wait/build; the three mutating ones are gated behind the official tools/pre-execute approval hook).
